PCI.BIO: Andres Medina is a valley native who graduated from UTPA's BSEE program in 2006.  Andres worked for Boeing for 8 years before accepting a Lecturer position at UTPA in 2014.

PASTHIST.TITLE: Lecturer I
PASTHIST.DESC: •	Courses Taught:  VLSI, Solid State Devices, Electronics II, Electronics I, Electronics I Lab, Electronics For Computer Engineers, Electrical Engineering Lab II, Electrical Engineering Lab I, Electric/Electronic Systems, Circuits 1, & Circuits-1 Lab.

PASTHIST.TITLE: Lead Flight Test Engineer L3
PASTHIST.DESC: •	Led team of engineers in ensuring the removal of all instrumentation and prototype parts from the entire 747-8 Freighter test fleet (“Refurbishment” of test aircraft).  Handled personnel issues, scheduling of shifts and overtime, and reporting status to upper management during weekly meetings.  Point of contact for all questions regarding flight test equipment such as prototype system computers and instrumentation equipment and wiring.

PASTHIST.TITLE: Flight Test Engineer L3
PASTHIST.DESC: •	Aircrew member responsible for maintaining aircraft gross weight and center of gravity within spec during in-flight tests.  Served as in-flight safety officer during flight tests.  Ensured correct aircraft test configuration prior to test via coordination with Design Engineering, FAA and Manufacturing.  Approved and tracked installation and removal of prototype equipment.  Inspected and authorized experimental aircraft for test flights.

PASTHIST.TITLE: PSS Laboratory Engineer L2
PASTHIST.DESC: •	Tested Passenger Service System prototype computers individually and at the system level. Captured system network traffic using Wireshark; dissected and analyzed Ethernet frames when troubleshooting system errors. Tested and troubleshot airplane systems emulators. Coordinated with various groups to ensure lab was equipped with the necessary equipment throughout the lifetime of the new aircraft development cycle.

PASTHIST.TITLE: PSS Design & Analysis Engineer L1
PASTHIST.DESC: •	Managed the redesign of legacy aircraft computers due to parts obsolescence issues and in-service issues.  Worked with airlines and suppliers to design custom installations/applications of airplane system computers.  Supported design reviews, developed test plans, test procedures and test reports to ensure compliance with product specifications and FAA regulations.  Tested prototype versions of system computers throughout the entire development cycle in both lab and aircraft environments.
